title: Azure Data Engineer - Power BI
description:

Max Experience: 20
  
  
Job Title: Azure Data Engineer – Power BI
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Azure Data Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure data services and Power BI. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, implementing ETL processes, managing data integration, and creating interactive Power BI dashboards and reports to support business intelligence and analytics.

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
* Build and manage ETL/ELT workflows for data integration.
* Work with Azure Data Lake Storage and Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries and data models.
* Create interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
* Develop Power BI datasets, semantic models, and DAX calculations.
* Implement data transformation using SQL, Python, or PySpark.
* Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* Optimize data processing and reporting performance.
* Implement data security, access controls, and governance.
* Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand reporting requirements.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in Microsoft Azure data engineering services.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Knowledge of Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).
* Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Strong SQL and database concepts.
* Experience in ETL/ELT development.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI dashboards and reports.
* Good knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.
* Experience with Python or PySpark.
* Understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling.
* Knowledge of Azure security and data governance.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Azure Databricks.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience with Delta Lake and Spark.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of incremental data loading and performance optimization.
* Experience integrating multiple data sources.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
Experience: 3–8 years (depending on project requirements).
  
  
Key Skills: Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, DAX, Power Query, SQL, Python, PySpark, Azure Databricks.

title: NewPage - Technical Principal - AI Solutions
description:
**Job Description :**
Tech Principal, AI Solutions. Location : Hybrid | Type : Full-time.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices. We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping : when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement, a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence : you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering. Third, delivery governance : you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably.
  
  
You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built : not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape Solutions in Discovery :
* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the client's problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end : target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually : layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership : team shape, phasing, milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.
* Set the Engineering Standards :
* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build : reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.
* Govern and Steer Delivery :
* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects : regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly : get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background : you have shaped engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products : RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models : you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for : QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams : technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication : you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft : you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer :
  
  

* A people-first culture : supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

title: Sr. Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
Design and optimize enterprise scale Kinaxis based supply chain planning solutions for a global organization ensuring robust demand and supply synchronization high system performance and reliable data integrity while collaborating closely with cross functional business stakeholders in a hybrid work model to deliver measurable value and operational resilience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design end to end Kinaxis RapidResponse supply planning solutions that align with enterprise supply chain strategies and support scalable global operations
* Architect robust data models and planning configurations in Kinaxis that ensure accurate demand and supply visibility across multiple business units and regions
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex planning scenarios into Kinaxis based workflows that improve service levels and inventory performance
* Optimize planning heuristics and algorithms within Kinaxis to enhance forecast accuracy capacity alignment and material availability for critical product lines
* Define integration patterns between Kinaxis and upstream as well as downstream applications to support seamless data flow and timely planning updates
* Review existing supply planning processes and identify transformation opportunities that leverage Kinaxis capabilities to reduce cycle times and planning effort
* Guide implementation teams on Kinaxis configuration standards and best practices to maintain consistency reusability and long term maintainability of the solution
* Conduct detailed impact assessments for change requests in Kinaxis to safeguard system stability performance and regulatory or compliance requirements
* Oversee performance tuning and monitoring activities for Kinaxis environments to ensure reliable response times and high availability for business users
* Develop comprehensive design documentation solution diagrams and configuration guides that support knowledge sharing and future enhancements in Kinaxis
* Collaborate with data and analytics teams to enable meaningful dashboards and supply planning insights that support informed executive decision making
* Mentor junior planners and technical analysts in the effective use of Kinaxis to solve real world planning challenges and to follow structured problem solving practices
* Partner with operations and procurement teams to ensure Kinaxis supply plans drive tangible improvements in customer satisfaction working capital and waste reduction

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive hands on experience in Kinaxis Fundamentals and Kinaxis Supply planning with a proven track record of delivering complex enterprise implementations
* Hold strong knowledge of supply chain planning concepts such as demand planning distribution planning capacity planning and inventory optimization in large organizations
* Demonstrate practical experience configuring Kinaxis planning workbooks what if scenarios alerts and supply planning workbenches for diverse business processes
* Show proficiency in data modeling data quality management and integration concepts relevant to Kinaxis deployments across multiple source and target systems
* Display familiarity with hybrid work environments collaborating effectively with distributed teams and stakeholders in virtual and on site settings during day shifts
* Apply advanced problem solving skills to diagnose planning exceptions resolve data inconsistencies and propose sustainable improvements in Kinaxis configurations
* Exhibit strong communication and presentation capabilities to explain complex Kinaxis design decisions to technical teams and non technical business partners
* Utilize experience of fifteen to nineteen years in supply chain or planning technology roles to provide mature judgment and practical guidance during critical project phases

**Certifications Required**
Kinaxis RapidResponse Author or equivalent Kinaxis certification preferred additional supply chain or planning certifications such as APICS CPIM are an advantage

This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.

**Conversion Strategy & Governance**

* Define the end-to-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.

* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.

* Author functional specifications for field-level, transaction-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims-in-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).

* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.

**Testing & Reconciliation**

* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy-level and aggregate-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

Ability to write field-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting-grade standards

Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion

**Job Title: Senior Manager – Solution Architecture**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. The ideal candidate will connect business processes, applications, data, integration, and cloud technologies to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.

**Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
* Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
* Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

**Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
* Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
* Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
* Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, product owners, and clients to clarify needs and translate them into feasible solution options.
* Present solution alternatives, investment needs, trade-offs, and risks to decision-makers; secure alignment on scope, target architecture, and expected business outcomes.
* Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
* Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
* Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
* Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.
* Expertise in secure solution design, identity and access management, data protection, and enterprise governance, with working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational support.

**Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide enterprise solutions from discovery and option assessment through design governance, implementation oversight, and transition to operations.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations, and risk assessments while managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, total cost of ownership analysis, modernization planning, and evaluating performance, resilience, and scalability trade-offs.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise business processes and data models; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience in finance transformation, ERP integration, analytics platforms, or data-led enterprise transformation is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and client-facing solution presentations.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, challenge assumptions constructively, and make clear decisions under ambiguity.
* High ownership mindset focused on solution quality, implementation feasibility, sustainable technology choices, and measurable business outcomes.

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

* Python

* Experience building utilities, ETL components, and automated testing frameworks.
* Production Support & Troubleshooting
* Experience handling production incidents, monitoring data pipelines, and performing root cause analysis.
* Ability to implement resiliency improvements and ensure pipeline stability.

Additional Expectations
  
  

* Ability to independently design and deliver medium-to-complex data engineering pipelines with minimal guidance.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Search Platform
description:
****Overview****
****Working at Atlassian****
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Your future team: Search Platform**
The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search , knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100+ sources. Your deep expertise in large-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.
  
  
As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world-class end-to-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.
* Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.
* Make hard architectural trade-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity - and own the outcomes.
* Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.
* Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real-world data - schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.
* Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.
* Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data-driven engineering across Search Data teams.
* Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.

****Qualifications****
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
****Requirements:****

* Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) - you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Ideally for Search and AI use cases where innovation relies on iterating over data. You understand their failure modes, not just their happy paths.
* Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale - including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.
* Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.
* Demonstrated department-level technical leadership, influence across multiple teams, and ownership of top-level technical objectives tied to business outcomes. You identify ambiguity and bring clarity.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.
* Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data architecture to engineers, product managers, and leadership with equal clarity.
* 12+ years of experience imagining, building and operating critical systems at scale.

****Benefits & Perks****
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
****About Atlassian****
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**

title: Technical Consultant-AI Integration
description:

Master's Degree

title: Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect
description:
Cognizant is looking to hire a Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect who will be part of the SCM AI practice within our Product Delivery Team (EPS). The role spans three areas: presales solutioning, running customer pilots in Supply Chain AI, and solutions architecture for new SC/AI offerings. You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery. A strong grasp of both AI-based solutioning and traditional SCM technical architecture is needed, along with depth in at least one functional area of Supply Chain.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**
Presales
  
  

* Own first-level technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs - AI/agentic solutions and traditional custom builds (integrations, data architecture)
* Map requests to existing solution patterns; escalate novel or complex asks to senior architecture review
* Provide effort sizing and feasibility calls under bid deadlines
* Draft technical solution sections of proposals - architecture, differentiators, risks, dependencies
* Apply Cognizant pricing model with reuse in mind

Customer Pilots
  
  

* Run customer pilots for SC AI solutions - scoping, execution, and measurement against KPIs
* Act as technical point of contact through the pilot lifecycle, coordinating with client and internal teams
* Convert pilot outcomes into case studies and reusable proof points

Solutions Architecture
  
  

* Design solution architecture for new SC/AI offerings - data models, integration patterns, platform-to-play mapping
* Liaise with platform teams (Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, SAP) on new capabilities
* Contribute to the SC AI play portfolio, keeping architecture reusable across clients

**Qualifications, Experience And Aptitude -**

* 8-12 years in SCM technology consulting, with presales/solution architecture exposure
* Hands-on experience with both AI/agentic solutions and traditional integration/data builds
* Strength in one SC functional area (Planning/Forecasting, WMS, Order Management, Control Tower) plus working knowledge across the broader SC landscape
* Working knowledge preferred across any of: Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, 09 (or similar)
* Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing exposure preferred
* Familiarity with AI maturity frameworks a plus
* Strong communication skills - clear technical writing under deadline pressure, confident client engagement during pilots
* Self-driven, proactive and attention to detail necessary
* Based in India (Bangalore/Chennai preferred); limited travel for pilot engagements

title: AI Platform Architect (Teradyne, India)
description:
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Architect
  
  
**Reports to:**
Enterprise AI Architect
  
  
**Our Purpose**
TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are challenged to innovate and learn something new every day.
  
  
We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
****What You Will Do****
As an AI Platform Architect I at Teradyne, you will help shape how AI is architected, integrated, and governed across the enterprise, spanning AI agent and MCP infrastructure, platform and connector integration, AI governance and risk processes, and enterprise AI literacy. Reporting to the Enterprise AI Architect, you will translate our enterprise AI strategy into concrete architecture patterns, deployment standards, and governance practices, primarily across Azure Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Claude.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical, architecture-focused role. You will define reusable patterns for deploying AI agents, standardize MCP server design and CI/CD pipelines, AI platform configuration, and set up authentication and authorization middleware for AI agents and services. You will also contribute to the enterprise AI gateway and connector strategy, support AI governance and risk-review processes, and help drive enterprise AI literacy, ensuring AI initiatives scale securely, consistently, and responsibly.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
AI Platform & Environment Enablement
  
  

* Manage platform settings, integrations, and resource allocations to ensure optimal performance and cost-efficiency for development teams
* Set up and maintain authentication/authorization middleware for AI agents and services, partnering with the team that owns enterprise identity/access management
* Standardize Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design, deployment templates, and infrastructure-as-code patterns
* Design and own CI/CD pipelines for AI agent, MCP, and/or AI model deployments (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)

****Business Outcome:****
Provide well-configured, secure, and efficient AI platform environments that enable teams to build and deploy AI solutions reliably.
  
  
**AI Solution Development**

* Define architecture patterns and standards for deploying AI agents across the enterprise, primarily on Azure Foundry, Microsoft Copilot / Copilot Studio / Copilot Cowork, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Claude
* Establish and document reusable playbooks and modular workflows for agentic AI development, ensuring rapid adoption and consistency across teams leveraging both no-code and programmatic development environments
* Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent infrastructure on cloud AI development platforms
* Contribute to the design and maintenance of the enterprise AI gateway, including the MCP registry, LLM traffic routing, observability, rate limiting, data redaction, and access control
* Contribute to the enterprise connector/integration strategy connecting AI tools to core business systems
* Lead architecture reviews for AI agent and enterprise copilot tooling deployments

****Business Outcome:****
Deliver well-architected, reusable AI solutions that accelerate adoption and demonstrate the value of enterprise AI investment.
  
  
**AI Governance, Security, and Observability**

* Contribute to AI governance and risk-review processes, including evaluating new LLMs before adoption and reviewing AI tool and connector requests
* Partner with security, legal, and compliance teams to help shape AI risk frameworks, policy, and data governance standards
* Contribute to enterprise AI literacy/training tracking and reporting

****Business Outcome:****
Strengthen AI governance and risk posture while building enterprise-wide AI literacy and capability.
  
  
****Required Qualifications****
  
  

* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in AI/ML or platform engineering, with hands-on experience deploying AI systems in an enterprise environment
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
* Technical Skills:

+ Required hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry
+ Additional experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Claude is ideal
+ Proficiency in Python and SQL
+ Hands-on experience building and deploying AI Agents and MCP Servers
+ Experience designing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
+ Experience with Infrastructure as Code
+ Some hands-on experience setting up authentication/authorization
+ Experience building custom RAG pipelines
+ Familiarity with AI governance/risk frameworks
+ Understanding of API/connector integration patterns for enterprise systems

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams
+ Analytical mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes
+ Comfortable contributing to governance and security review processes

**Why Join Teradyne?**
At Teradyne, we are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and empowering our teams to deliver cutting-edge AI solutions that drive business value. As an AI Platform Architect I, you will have the opportunity to work on transformative projects, collaborate with talented professionals, and shape the future of AI at Teradyne. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining what's possible with AI.

title: Staff Applied Scientist
description:
**Take your career to new heights with Loopio! 🚀✨**
We’re hiring a
**Staff Applied Scientist**
to help build the knowledge and AI foundation behind Loopio’s products.
  
  
This role is for someone who has built knowledge graphs and AI agents in production and wants to own the science behind them. As a Staff-level scientist, you’ll also set technical direction, mentor senior talent, and shape how applied ML is done across the team.
  
  
This role requires close collaboration with teams across Canada, the UK, and India. To accommodate the time zone differences, you will be expected to work from 11 am - 7:30 pm IST.
  
  
This is a remote-first role where you can work from anywhere in India.
  
  
**💻 What You’ll Be Doing**
**Applied Science**

* Design and build knowledge graphs that turn unstructured content into structured, reliable knowledge.
* Build agents and agentic retrieval systems that find, check, and use that knowledge.
* Use feedback from real users to keep knowledge accurate and improve results over time.
* Define how we measure quality, and use those measures to decide what ships.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Set technical direction and make build vs. buy calls on tools and approaches.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and other AI teams to turn research into features customers use.
* Mentor engineers and data scientists, and set the standards for how the team runs experiments and ships models.

**✨ What You’ll Bring To The Team**
**ML, NLP & Evaluation**

* 8+ years applying ML in production.
* Strong background in NLP and LLMs. Experience with RAG is expected.
* Experience with finetuning LLM and classical ML is expected.
* Track record of designing evaluations and using them to decide what ships.

**Knowledge Graphs & Agents**

* 3+ years building knowledge graphs in production, including ontology design, information extraction, and entity resolution.
* Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and query languages like Cypher.
* 3+ years building LLM-based agents in production, including planning, tool use, and orchestration.
* Experience making agents reliable through evaluation, guardrails, and human review.

**Engineering & Leadership**

* Strong Python and software engineering skills, with experience shipping ML services to production.
* Experience setting technical direction and mentoring senior engineers and data scientists.
* Ability to explain technical trade-offs in terms of customer value.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with graph neural networks or knowledge graph embeddings.
* Published work or open-source contributions in knowledge graphs, information extraction, or agents.

**Where You’ll Work 📍**

* This is a remote-first opportunity with the advantages of working flexibly across India.
* We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from. Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in 🇨🇦 Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), 🇺🇲 US, 🇮🇳 India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru), and 🇬🇧 London.
* Our India/UK hub employees work according to the business hours stated in the job description above. This is intentionally designed to enable our global teams to have overlapping hours for collaboration.
* You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work 🙇🏾 during the workday
* We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global #OneTeam!

**Why You’ll ❤️ Working at Loopio**

* Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice for our 1:1s and performance conversations
* You will have the opportunity to elevate 🪄 your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact.
* We’ll set you up to work remotely with a MacBook laptop 🍏, a monthly phone and internet subsidy, and a work-from-home budget to help get your home office all set up.
* We’ll give you a Claude account to experiment with, automate your routine tasks, and build tools so you can work smarter every day.
* You’ll be joining a supportive culture that has thoughtfully built out opportunities for connections in a remote first environment.
* Participate in 🎤 townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and company celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!
* Our four Employee Resource Groups offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round.
* You’ll be a part of an award-winning workplace 🏆with an opportunity to make a big impact on the business.

**Questioning your qualifications? Read this**
‼️ Hi there, we recognize that all too often, potential candidates don’t apply for a position simply because they don’t hit every single criteria included in the job description—particularly members of underrepresented groups.
  
  
Whether or not your experience ✅ checks off all the boxes on a job posting, we still encourage you to apply to ensure that your application receives a review from our team. We understand that a resume can only showcase so much during the applicant stage, so we've created prompts in the application for you to share more about yourself. If you've made a career transition (or a few!), you’re self taught in a new role, or you have skills/experience you’d like to highlight, we want to hear more about what you could bring to the table.
  
  
**AI in Recruitment 👩🏻‍💻**
At Loopio, we leverage artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines
  
  
**AI Usage in Interviews**
🤖 The Loopio interview process is designed to help us better understand your professional experiences, as well as your unique perspective and approach to delivery and collaboration. To ensure a fair and accurate assessment, we expect candidates to refrain from using AI-generated content to produce responses to our interview questions during the live interview, as our goal is to evaluate your own knowledge and problem-solving abilities - not those of an AI assistant. If AI-generated responses are identified during the interview, Loopio reserves the right to disqualify candidates from the interview process.
  
  
For specific roles that include a take-home assignment, our AI Interviewee Policy allows the use of AI for initial support; however, the final submission must be a true reflection of your personal insights, skills and decision-making.
  
  
*Loopio is an equal opportunity employer that is deeply committed to building equitable workplaces that are diverse and inclusive. We actively encourage candidates from
**all**
backgrounds and lifestyles to consider us as a future employer. Please contact a member of our Talent Experience team (*
*work@loopio.com*
*) should you require accommodations at any point during our virtual interview processes.*

**Description**

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. **Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Team Size : 10 -15

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

Subject line: Application — Strategic Research & Business Analyst

**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We stream 650+ Bengali movies, 185+ originals, and 3000+ hours of content to an audience of ~250 million Bengalis worldwide. We're part of the wider SVF ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.

We are scaling our AI ambitions through a company-wide push to embed AI into how all we operate, anchored by a dedicated AI brain.

**What you'll do :**

hoichoi already runs a comprehensive data setup for consumer and content data. As AI at hoichoi expands, that same architecture needs to extend to cover it too — including turning unstructured content into knowledge that in-house AI agents and applications can actually use.

You'll own the day-to-day health of that data: schemas, availability, and fixing what breaks, working in close, daily contact with our engineering team and in direct support of the AI team.

* Process data requests from other teams — building views and data-set bundles for analytics use.
* Own day-to-day data hygiene: schema health, data availability, and fixing breakages as they occur.
* Work in close, daily contact with the engineering team; this is a high-involvement, high-contact role by design.
* Support the AI team with AI-ready data — including embeddings/vector pipelines, chunking, and handling unstructured content (video metadata, subtitles, synopses, thumbnails) — alongside your core data engineering work.
* Help extend hoichoi's existing data architecture to adopt new methodologies around transforming structured and unstructured data into knowledge consumed by in-house AI agents and applications as it grows.
* Build and maintain orchestration/transformation pipelines and streaming or event-ingestion pipelines (clickstream, CDC) that keep data flowing reliably.
* Own data governance and PII handling for consumer data, in line with DPDP Act compliance.

**Must have qualifications :**

* 2–6 years of experience in data engineering, with hands-on schema and pipeline work.
* Strong SQL fluency.
* Comfortable owning data hygiene end-to-end — not just building pipelines, but fixing what breaks in them.
* Experience with modern analytics/data technologies — ClickHouse, MongoDB, Postgres, or similar modern RDBMS/NoSQL databases.
* Experience with orchestration/transformation tooling (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or equivalent) and streaming/event-ingestion pipelines (Kafka, CDC, clickstream).
* AI-first by default — you actively use AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) in your own work rather than defaulting to hand-coding everything, with at least one end-to-end example where AI generated significant code you debugged or overrode. This matters more to us than raw years of experience.
* Awareness of data governance, PII handling, and DPDP Act compliance — this role touches consumer data directly.
* Should stay on top of the latest Data & AI technology trends, and work closely with the AI and technology teams to bring relevant ones in.

**Good to have :**

* Experience in a media, streaming, or content platform environment.
* Exposure to preparing or structuring data specifically for AI/ML use cases.
* Excellent knowledge of modern data concepts — self-healing data pipelines, Knowledge Graphs, Ontologies.
* Data-quality/observability tooling experience (tests, monitoring, schema-drift alerting).
* Any relevant AI certifications (e.g., Anthropic Claude certifications) or data engineering/AI certifications from major hyperscalers.

**Culture & How We Work**

At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.

* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
